order.hypothesis: Reduce repeated measure_kg time on a cold engine restart of an already qualified exact GPU/model/profile, while keeping ordinary serving and every missing/stale receipt fallback intact.

contract.cpu_source: replace only the named GgmlEngine.__init__ definition; same signature and fallbacks
contract.cold: fresh restricted process to completion of first fixed 32-client, 32-token mixed wave
contract.warm: second mixed wave and 18 factual checks on the same engine
contract.gate: two A/A observations then six alternating pairs, matching outputs/work, all cold wins, median cold gain >=2% and exceeds observed A/A variation, warm median time and p95 TTFT ratios <=1.02, host and device memory <=1.05x; signed stale-profile negative must fall back
contract.scope: repeat verified deployment startup only; no claim of faster warm generation

receipt_protocol.fields: schema, binding, mask, created_s, quality. binding has model_sha256, model_stat (list of st_dev, st_ino, st_size, st_mtime_ns, st_ctime_ns from the verified mounted GGUF), native (ggml_binary.identity()), fp (kernel_gen.fingerprint()), w4_sha256, table_sha256, settings (self.settings), seqs, seq_ctx, threads, max_rows, speculate, gpu_layers, affinity (sorted list), flags (exact effective full native execution flag dict), and measure_kg_sha256 (sha256(inspect.getsource(GgmlEngine.measure_kg).encode())). Native flags bound by name in binding.flags: IRONMULE_PS1, IRONMULE_PS1_WARM, IRONMULE_PS1_CONCAT, IRONMULE_PK6, IRONMULE_GGML_DH2, IRONMULE_SV5, IRONMULE_GGML_PACK, IRONMULE_GGML_UBATCH, IRONMULE_CUBLAS_MIN_ROWS, IRONMULE_CUDA_GRAPHS_ROWS.
receipt_protocol.quality: quality.completed == 32, quality.facts == 18, quality.output_sha256 is 64 hex. mask is the original complete GgmlEngine.measure_kg() dict including both admitted width lists. Both outputs are already qualified in an unmodified reference on this machine. Only accept age 0..86400 seconds, a bound external SHA, valid values, equal model stat or independently rehash the GGUF, identical CUDA/native/build/env/geometry and W4+table bytes. Binding is from reference, not from candidate. The trusted broker selects/pins the receipt. Never trust arbitrary caller files.
receipt_protocol.fallback: On missing/malformed/stale/nonmatching receipt, width/mask setter/getter discrepancy, disabled kernel_mask, KG4 explicit scope, or any missing identity, retain normal upstream behavior. No partial mask installation: restore original registers before measuring if application failed. Successful replay must set/read back both mask registers and restore the runtime state the measured path normally leaves. Emit self.kg['restart_profile_reused']=True ONLY on positive replay; do not change other performance, quality, calibration or budget criteria. The worker has no writable store.
